briefing: Pluto is small, cold, and far away.
Some people say Pluto is not a planet anymore, but we came anyway.
Pluto has a giant heart shape on its surface, made of frozen nitrogen ice.
It has five moons, and the biggest one, Charon, is almost half its size.
Nobody has ever placed a beacon this far out, so let's go be the first.
preflightLine: Last belt. Last beacon. Everything you've typed got us here. One more.
warpSentence: Pluto is small, cold, and far away.
beaconFlavor: Not a planet. Still on the map. The path is lit from Earth to here.
